note: Sample values for the testnet demo, not a real pour. Each value carries its source or an 'assumption' label. On chain, ticketHash is the sha256 of the pour's ticket_doc, epdHash the sha256 of the delivered mix's epd_doc, and the baselineMixHash the sha256 of the baseline mix's epd_doc (sample documents in data/sample-docs, built from these values).

akcansa_nrmca_epd.note: Published EPD of a Turkish cement producer (NRMCA program, US PCR, not EN 15804). Read 11 Oct 2026 (arastirma/hazirlik.md).

mit_cshub_overdesign.quote: savings of over 80 kg CO2e /m3, a 25 percent reduction
mit_cshub_overdesign.note: context for the saving range, not used in calculation

mix_a_baseline.label: Mix A (contractor's declared baseline, standard spec)
mix_a_baseline.cement_type: Portland cement Type I/II (CEM I equivalent)
mix_a_baseline.other_basis: assumption: aggregates, water, admixture, batching; not modeled

mix_b_actual.label: Mix B (delivered leaner mix)
mix_b_actual.cement_basis: assumption: optimized mix; the maturity record supports early-age decisions, acceptance stays with the 28-day specimens

P-001.story: Leaner-mix pour with a declared baseline; curing record from Box 1 of the dataset; strength approved by the inspector; saving claimed once.
P-001.curing_curve: replayed from published dataset (Mendeley nmr8pjx8d8, CC BY 4.0; Utepov et al. 2021). The dataset's own concrete is class B25 / grade M350 from a batching plant (paper p.3); its cement type and content are not published. On screen: 'curing curve: published dataset (class B25), not Mix B'. Mix A/B values stay as labelled sample values.

strength_reference.ui_rule: show as reference only; inspector decides

P-002.story: Tamper case: the simulated device replayed the dataset's open-air series instead of concrete. Same declared baseline as P-001. Signatures are valid; the rule-based curing check flags it, the inspector does not approve, and without approval the ledger refuses the saving claim.
